messages:
jamal: Quick sync — drafting release notes for v1.6.0. Target release window: Thu 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC. Need final bullets, pin decision, and rollback steps. @sasha @marta @ana @kevin
sasha: Quick notes: include model pinning to rdx-model-v1.6.0-quant (Q8). Call out expected perf: 18ms median token. Also add changelog bullet about /v1/embedding response shape tweak.
marta: Ops acked change window. I'll update the runbook. Adding rollback commands below.
marta: ```
# rollback to pinned model
rdctl deploy rollback --service=inference --to=rdx-model-v1.5.9
# fallback route
rdctl route set --service=inference --prefix=/v1/legacy --target=legacy-backend
```
ana: From product: add a single-sentence user-facing blurb for the internal announcement: "Improved latency and cost with model quantization; backward-compatible endpoints continue to work."
kevin: Oncall: I can monitor 22:00-00:00 UTC, will set up alert threshold: latency > 3x baseline or error rate > 1%. Put my name in the runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy-plan created: canary(10%) -> ramp(50%) -> full(100%). Estimated duration: 45m. Link: https://deploys.internal/runs/7890
jamal: Thanks — I'll update the draft. Two asks: 1) confirm the exact pinned model string for release notes; 2) final approval for the rollback commands.
sasha: Confirmed: rdx-model-v1.6.0-quant-q8-20260320
marta: Rollback commands look good. Suggest adding db-migration check before full ramp.
jamal: OK I'll add a pre-ramp migration check step. Draft release note snippet below — please :eyes: and thumbs up if ok.
jamal: ```
Release v1.6.0 (2026-03-25)
- Model: rdx-model-v1.6.0-quant-q8 (pinned for release)
- Improvements: ~20% median latency reduction; 2x cost improvement for embeddings workloads
- API: embedding response shape updated — backward compatible, clients should prefer new schema
- Ops: change window Thu 22:00 UTC; rollback plan included in internal runbook
```
ana: text LGTM. Recommend adding one line for rollback SLA: "If >5% users impacted, automatic rollback to v1.5.9."
kevin: I'll add the alert playbook and run the dry-run on staging at 18:00 UTC today.
sasha: :shipit: pending kevin dry-run and marta signoff on migration check
jamal: Great. I'll merge the notes and send the internal announcement at 20:30 UTC once dry-run passes.
deploy-bot: canary started (10%) — run 7890 — status: in progress
